shots.title: A lever changes one string.
shots.detail: Down is the open pitch.

shots.title: Raise it one semitone.
shots.detail: The lever shortens the speaking length.

shots.title: A-flat becomes A.
shots.detail: Natural strings become sharps.

shots.title: Change every matching octave.
shots.detail: Then confirm and hear the scale.

shots.title: Begin in E-flat.
shots.detail: All levers down.

shots.title: Raise A, E and B.
shots.detail: Now the harp is in C major.

shots.title: Add F for G major.
shots.detail: F becomes F-sharp.

shots.title: Listen from G to G.
shots.detail: The root gives the scale its home.

EarpaLeverMasterclass.approval: ANIMATED LESSON: teacher review and narration approval pending

shots.title: Meet the sharping lever.
shots.detail: It raises a string by one semitone.

shots.title: A shorter speaking length.
shots.detail: The lever contacts the string. The pitch rises.

shots.title: Your open tuning matters.
shots.detail: E-flat tuning begins with B-flat, E-flat and A-flat.

shots.title: One clockwise step.
shots.detail: Raise A-flat to A: E-flat major becomes B-flat major.

shots.title: Then raise E.
shots.detail: Keep A raised. E-flat becomes E: now F major.

shots.title: Then raise B.
shots.detail: A, E and B raised: C major.

shots.title: Continue with F, C, G, D.
shots.detail: Each new major key raises one more letter group.

shots.title: Modes change the home note.
shots.detail: C-major levers, D as home: D Dorian.

shots.title: Set. Confirm. Listen.
shots.detail: Play the scale from its root to the root above. Some keys require retuning.
